name: figma-pack
description: Mdigital Figma workflow: connect a design system by one link, design layouts in Figma with our components, and turn designs into React (web), React Native or Flutter code.

interface.longDescription: Draw screens in Figma from the Mbank and project design systems, read approved mockups into a neutral spec, and build React, React Native or Flutter code by the Mdigital standards.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $figma-core to route this Figma task: draw in Figma, connect a design system, or build code from a mockup.
